title: 이견 없음
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B with jazz-pop influences. The arrangement features a clean, chorus-effected electric guitar playing syncopated jazz chords and a melodic bassline that emphasizes the groove. A steady mid-tempo drum kit provides a crisp backbeat with prominent hi-hat work. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, conversational tenor, transitioning into a light falsetto during melodic peaks. A subtle electric piano adds harmonic depth in the background. The track is in the key of E Major with a tempo of 92 BPM in 4/4 time.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar playing syncopated jazz chords]
[melodic electric bass enters]

[Verse 1]
[smooth male tenor vocals]
새벽 두 시 파란 모니터
슬라이드 열네 장
일곱 번째의 내 의견이 있어
커피가 식어가 세 번째 식어가
형광등이 윙윙거려 엔터를 누르고 저장
오전 열 시에 말할 거야 일곱 번째를 열 거야

[Chorus]
[drums enter with a crisp backbeat]
의견 있는 사람 대리가 먼저 입을 열어 0.4초
